articles.title: Two Planets Fluffier Than Cotton Candy Found in Space
articles.summary: Astronomers found two giant planets that are less dense than cotton candy. They are called TOI-791 b and c, and they orbit a star 1,113 light-years away. Only a few super-puff planets exist!

articles.title: This Computer Runs on DNA and Fits in a Drop of Water
articles.summary: Scientists built a tiny computer made of DNA that can do math in a drop of water. It uses billions of molecules to solve problems, like 10 + 3, in about 30 seconds.

articles.title: 9-Year-Old's Minecraft Videos Cost Dad $100K and His Job
articles.summary: A 9-year-old boy spent over $100,000 on YouTube ads for his Minecraft channel. His dad lost his job and might lose their house. The story has over 3 million views.
